free_text_notes.physician_note: 60-year-old woman with hypothyroidism, hypertension, admitted 6/2 for left total hip arthroplasty. Post-op day 2; pain controlled on oral regimen.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Vitals stable this shift. Tolerating diet. A mild rash appeared briefly at the IV insertion site on day 2. It was assessed as a minor irritation, treated with a topical cream, and has fully resolved.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with daughter. 6/4 18:00: Per pharmacy, oxycodone changed from 5 mg every 4 hours as needed to 5 mg every 6 hours as needed, 5-day supply. No documentation that the patient or family has been informed of the new dose. Need to update the PCP before discharge. Daughter normally works days but has taken the afternoon off to drive the patient home at the planned time.
